title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
summary: Norihiro Yagi, the creator of Claymore, began serializing a new manga titled Bartlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday. Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ. in November 2007, where it ended in October 2014. title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Comisma Plan 10 Billion Yen Anime Production Fund
summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and IP platform company Comisma have agreed in principle to establish an investment fund focused on anime production, targeting 10 billion yen (approximately US$63.4 million) in assets under management by the end of fiscal 2027. The initiative aims to broaden access to production financing, attract a broader range of investors, and improve financial returns for creators as demand for Japanese animation continues to grow worldwide.
